summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, analyzing them via Ouroboros and Mycelium, and feeding synthesized patterns back into the system as a continuous overnight autoresearch loop.
summary.outcome: Built a complete EVO modeling closed-loop (E1-E64 experiments), fixed a critical SET-vs-additive bug in `apply_mycelium_feedback` that caused Mycelium compounding to decay each cycle, validated the convergence formula `consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n`, added 11 regression tests, and fixed multiple pre-existing test failures across ARC, compound, and cache modules.

repo: `run_llm_deliberation()` unconditionally SETs `_score_adjustments[vt]` on every call, wiping any Mycelium calibration before the next deliberation sees it — experiments must call `nexus.deliberate()` directly or use `_mycelium_calibration` (the stable cross-cycle accumulator) to survive across LLM deliberations

SurrealDB HTTP API requires `RETURN true;` as the health probe — `SELECT 1;` returns HTTP 400. Datetime fields require `time::now()` not string literals. SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields; use `result` (option<string>) as a JSON escape hatch
Gemini worktrees at `.gemini/worktrees/` are silently cleaned up and will delete uncommitted work — never leave production fixes uncommitted when operating from a worktree
`autoresearch.jsonl` is tracked by git but written continuously by the overnight loop — pre-commit stash/restore fails when this file is modified; either gitignore it or commit with `--no-verify`
Pre-commit playwright hook has no `files:` filter and blocks every commit regardless of whether UI files changed — adding `files: '\.(tsx?|jsx?|css)$'` scopes it correctly

UCB1 sorting for beam search should govern expansion order but NOT determine the best final answer — a confirmed-score-1.0 transform loses to an untested transform (UCB1=∞), so best_chain must be tracked separately from the exploration beam

The convergence formula for Mycelium additive compounding is exact: `calibration_per_voice = gap × 0.5 × lr`; at lr=2.0 this closes the entire gap (0.725→0.850) in one synthesis cycle with max_error=0.00025 (IEEE 754 noise only)

`psutil.virtual_memory` returns real system pressure during tests — executor tests that check memory guardrails will fail on high-memory machines unless `psutil.virtual_memory` is patched to return unconstrained values

The retirement criterion for converged experiments: retire if (a) CV of last 10 keep-metrics < 0.05 AND n_keeps ≥ 20 (converged attractor), or (b) keep_frac == 0.0 AND n_runs ≥ min_runs (confirmed noise)

code.finding: E57 fix: `apply_mycelium_feedback` changed from SET (`_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment`) to additive (`_mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]`). Without this, cycle 2 replaced cycle 1's calibration with a smaller value as the observed mean crept up, causing decay instead of compounding. `_mycelium_calibration` must be initialized in `__init__` as `dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0)`.

`_evaluate_resource` only checked `budget_available` context — adding description keyword scoring (+0.10 for 'cost'/'budget'/'efficient'/'resource'/'reduce') makes the heuristic text-sensitive and consistent with engineer/ethicist/architect voice evaluation patterns.

The original `SurrealDBClient` was entirely simulated — `connect()` set `self.connected = True` without any HTTP call. Replaced with real `httpx`-based implementation. The `journey_point` schema requires `metadata = {}` (empty object, not omitted) and `timestamp = time::now()` (not a string literal). EVO biographies must be stored in `result` (option<string>) as JSON since SCHEMAFULL blocks undeclared nested metadata fields.

Beam search used UCB1 for both expansion selection AND final answer selection. With `trials=0` giving UCB1=∞, untested transforms always ranked above a confirmed score=1.0 transform. Fix: track `best_chain` separately across all candidates by actual score, independent of the UCB1-ordered exploration beam.

`red_team_veto` only checked if 'contradiction' appeared in the strategy string, but `create_contradiction` injects physical impossibilities without using that word. Fix: also check if any perspective's critique contains `'CONTRADICTION: True'`.

All 6 `vault_write` call sites were calling an async method synchronously with no `await`. Fixed by adding a `_fire_vault_write` helper that uses `asyncio.get_event_loop().create_task()` when a loop is running, falling back to `asyncio.run()` otherwise.

`find_project_root` raised an error when no `.context` directory was found instead of falling back to the repo root (which has `pyproject.toml`). This caused `test_compound_cycle` to fail whenever tests ran outside the exact project structure.

New file: 11 tests protecting the E57 additive calibration fix. Critical: the synthesized skill format for `apply_mycelium_feedback` uses `'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX'` pattern (output of `_synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill`), NOT the `voice_scores=[...]` format used by `ingest_evo_journeys` input. Test helpers must match the synthesis output format.

The inversion test used `[[0,1],[1,0]] → [[1,0],[0,1]]` which is solvable by BOTH `invert` AND `flip_h` (horizontal flip). Since `flip_h` is first in the ops list, DFS returns it before reaching `invert`. Test data must be unambiguous — use patterns that only inversion (not any geometric transform) can produce.

`asyncio.wait_for(coro, timeout=remaining_s - 10)` creates a spin loop when `remaining_s < 10` — negative timeouts raise `TimeoutError` immediately after one event-loop iteration, burning CPU until the outer deadline check finally passes. Fix: `max(30.0, remaining_s - 10)` and break the loop early when `remaining_s < 30`.

workflow: E55-E62 experimental design pattern: specify hypothesis + null hypothesis + falsification criterion before running, not after. Experiments E50/E54/E47 each needed 2-3 redesigns because the keep criterion was unachievable or measured the wrong thing.

Retirement criterion prevents experiments running thousands of times past convergence: E51 ran 4,786 times because nothing said 'stop'. The retirement rule (CV < 0.05 after 20 keeps) automatically prunes the schedule — E12 would retire immediately (CV=0.00004 across all runs).

JEPA world model learning requires distributional diversity — in heuristic mode all deliberations produce near-identical 12D state vectors (single attractor). The model memorizes 'always predict high surprise' and replay buffers don't help. Real JEPA learning requires LLM mode where voice scores genuinely vary.

IEEE 754 precision matters for threshold-crossing experiments: `sum([0.85]*10)/10 < 0.85` returns True due to floating-point rounding. Use `result.approved` (direct threshold comparison in the class) as the canonical crossing signal, not float mean recomputation.

When an interactive rebase (`git rebase -i`) is left in-progress by another process, `git rebase --abort` is required before any branch operations — attempting checkout or commit fails with 'interactive rebase in progress'.

The `timeit.default_timer()` (alias for `time.perf_counter()`) is the correct timer for experiment wall-clock measurement — unaffected by NTP corrections or system clock adjustments during long runs, unlike `time.time()`.

Lemonade inference server silent failure mode: the `/models` endpoint returns 200 but all evaluation prompts return empty strings. A functional probe (`'2+2='`) must be used to detect this state before enabling LLM mode in the overnight loop.

Voice→Manifold mapping for gymnasium EVO experiments: Architect→space dims [0-2], Engineer→field dims [4,5,8], Ethicist→control dim [9], Resource→precipitation dim [11]. Optimal proposals spend +9.7% more episode time in HIHO and converge 25 steps faster.
